description:
**JUNIOR INTERIOR DESIGNER**

**Employment Type: Full Time**

**Budget: Up to 3 LPA**

**Experience: 1.5- 2 Years**

**Work Location: Balewadi, Pune 411045**

**ROLE OVERVIEW :**

We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented Junior Interior Designer to support design development, visualisation, working drawings, material research, and project coordination for interior projects. The role involves working closely with clients, vendors, consultants, and site teams to bring design concepts to life.

• 1.5– 2 years of experience in interior design, interior projects, or a related field.

• Background in Civil Engineering, Interior Design, or Interior Construction preferred.

• Good command of AutoCAD and presentation tools.

• Understanding of working drawings and site execution.

• Strong design sensibility, creativity, and attention to detail.

• Good communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

• Proactive attitude and ability to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

• Ability to speak English, Hindi, and/or Marathi.

**KEY SKILLS**

Interior Design | Design Concepts | Mood Boards | Material Palettes | AutoCAD | Working Drawings | Visualisation | Presentations | Material Research | Furniture & Lighting Selection | Client Coordination | Vendor Coordination | Site Visits | Project Tracking | Site Coordination

title: Electrical Designer Level II
description:
**About Us**
Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
**The Role**
***As an Electrical Designer Level II with Worley,***
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  

* Monitor own progress and ensure it comes within project schedule.
* Produce and check work packs and drawings.
* Guiding designer team in their day to day activities.
* Provide information to assist in the production of detailed drawings, quantities and materials lists.
* Routine equipment selection (involving complex calculations).
* Ensure that the level of design work is appropriate for the complexity of the construction tasks.
* Ensure work done conforms to the applicable specifications, codes and standards.
* Ensure technical Integrity of design deliverables.
* Knowledge and compliance with drafting procedures and drawing systems and applications.
* Knowledge of document control drawing systems.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* 3-D modelling and extraction of drawings from model.
* Liaison with other disciplines on technical issues and incorporate comments.
* Liaise with lead engineers regarding development work or construction.
* Liaise with suppliers, clients, consultants or commissioning engineers concerning design, installation or construction.
* Participate in the planning of projects as required.
* Conduct site visit and data gathering.
* Preparation and checking of as-built drawings.
* Assist lead engineer in preparation of material requisition (Requisition For Quotation) for electrical works and bulk materials.
* Assist lead engineer in preparation of technical bid evaluations for electrical works and bulk materials.
* Assist lead engineer in review of vendor drawings for electrical works and bulk materials.

+ Maintaining records of drawings and other documents as assigned by Lead Engineer.
+ Preparation of transmittals for IDC, ICC and AFC drawings.
+ Quality Assurance – Responsible for working within the provisions and guidelines of the Quality Assurance system relevant to the CSG..
+ Safety – Responsible for personal safety safe working practices for the CSG. Understand and follow OH&S procedures.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* ITI (Draftsman)/Diploma in electrical engineering.
* 8 - 15 years + design experience with oil and Gas, Refinery and Petrochemicals.
* Sound knowledge of AutoCAD/Microstation and S3D/E3D software.
* Added advantages of SmartSketch(S3D) /Draft(E3D) will be considered.
* Preference will be given to candidates with extensive work experience with Oil and Gas, Refinery and Petrochemicals and power projects.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
  
  
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Lighting Control Technical Designer
description:
**About Signify**
Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.
  
  
At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.
  
  
Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.
  
  
**Job Summary**
**More about the role**
We are seeking a
**Lighting Controls Technical Designer**
to join our Genlyte Design Team. In this role, you will develop and deliver customized lighting and controls solutions for a wide range of commercial, industrial, and infrastructure applications.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with sales, quotations, field services, and cross-functional teams to support projects from initial design through proposal and execution. This position combines technical design expertise with direct agent and end user support, playing a key role in delivering high-value, complex lighting system solutions.
  
  
Key Areas of Responsibility
  
  
Participate in customer projects through all phases from design to proposal through completion. You will be primarily involved in design applications/solutions and assist in proposal development of high-value/high-complexity projects.
  
  
**Additional Responsibilities Include**

* Participate in projects through all phases—from design and proposal development to execution and completion
* Design and develop lighting control systems for interior, exterior and site & area style applications
* Review electrical and architectural documentation (reflected ceiling plans, riser diagrams, panel schedules, fixture schedules, and power plans) to create tailored controls system solutions
* Generate project-specific device layouts, schematics, and drawings using tools such as AutoCAD and Bluebeam
* Develop bills of materials, submittal packages, and supporting technical documentation
* Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Product Management, Technical Support, Quotations) and external stakeholders to support proposals and project delivery
* Provide technical expertise to support existing and new business opportunities
* Support commissioning and installation through detailed design documentation
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines and quality expectations are met

Critical Experiences
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical,Electronics preferred), with relevant experience up to 5 years preferred.
* Strong experience interpreting electrical drawings.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD & Bluebeam
* Solid understanding of lighting systems, controls, and electrical installations
* Knowledge of communication protocols such as 0-10V, DALI, DMX, BACnet, Art-Net, or TCP/IP
* Familiarity with Building Management Systems (BMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), or automation systems is a plus
* Working knowledge of applicable codes and standards (NEC, IES, ASHRAE) and emergency lighting controls
* Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
* Flexibility to adapt to evolving project requirements and business needs

**Everything we’ll do for you**
You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.
  
  
Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

title: Instructional Designer ( 2pm - 10pm hrs )
description:
Instructional Designer – Global Learning

Location: Pune, India. Onsite with starting time 2pm to finishing time at 10pm.

Function: Instructional Design / Content Development

Reports to: Lead Instructional Designer

Works closely with: Content Development Project Managers, SMEs, eLearning Developers, Graphic Designers, Video/Media Specialists, Technical Writers and Assessment Specialists

**About SureSkills :**
SureSkills is a global edtech services company and market leader in technical education. We design and deliver engaging, high-impact learning experiences for some of the world’s most innovative technology companies — including Google, AWS, Microsoft, VMware, Meta, and Coursera. Our programmes combine expert-led instruction with hands-on labs, helping learners move from foundational knowledge to real-world mastery.

**The Role:**
We're looking for experienced Instructional Designers to design engaging, effective and scalable learning experiences for a large-scale global learning programme. Working within the Content Development Team, you'll translate learning objectives, source material and business requirements into practical learning experiences across a variety of formats and modalities. You'll work closely with SMEs and specialist content production teams to take learning solutions from initial design through development, review and final delivery. The learning environment supports global adult learners working in complex operational environments, so you'll need to be comfortable taking detailed or rapidly changing subject matter and turning it into learning that is clear, practical and focused on helping people perform effectively in their roles.

**What You'll Be Doing**

• Design learning experiences aligned with agreed learning objectives, pathways and instructional standards.

• Analyse source material and work with SMEs to understand the knowledge, skills and behaviours learners need to develop.

• Create detailed design documents, storyboards, scripts and content specifications.

• Design eLearning, virtual learning, instructor-led learning, self-directed learning, simulations, job aids and performance-support materials.

• Design meaningful practice activities that allow learners to apply new knowledge and skills.

• Develop assessment approaches and questions in partnership with the Assessment Specialist.

• Translate complex technical, policy or operational information into clear and engaging learning experiences.

• Work closely with eLearning Developers and multimedia specialists to bring designs to life.

• Review developed content to ensure it accurately reflects the approved instructional design.

• Incorporate feedback from SMEs, stakeholders and quality reviewers.

• Ensure learning solutions meet agreed accessibility, usability and inclusive design standards.

• Design for global audiences and support localisation and adaptation where required.

• Apply programme templates, standards and design systems consistently.

• Use learner feedback, assessment results and other available data to improve learning experiences. #

• Manage your own design workload effectively and meet agreed project milestones. • Participate in peer reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of the team's instructional design practice.

**What We're Looking For**

• 4+ years' experience in instructional design, learning design or digital learning.

• Strong knowledge of adult learning and instructional design principles.

Kāli is building a contemporary luxury house from India, with handbags and jewellery shaped by material, craft, mythology and design. We are looking for a designer who wants to work close to the objects themselves and help shape how the world encounters them.

This is a varied, hands-on role for someone trained in accessory design, with a particular interest in handbags, leather goods or jewellery. You will move between product thinking, visual storytelling, content and the website, helping turn ideas into work people can see, feel and remember.

title: Senior Product Designer: Design Systems
description:
**Description**
Senior Product Designer: Design Systems
  
  
The Position Do you dream about creating a more sustainable future? At Uplight, we are motivating energy users and providers to accelerate the clean energy ecosystem. Working with over 80 of the world’s leading electric and gas utilities, Uplight provides an end-to-end customer energy experience. Uplight delivers personalized experiences that customers have now come to expect–improving satisfaction, increasing revenue, reducing the cost to serve, and contributing to carbon reduction goals. We are B Corp certified, enabling us to put our values into action by not only making decisions for the benefit of our shareholders, but also for our customers, environment, employees, and community.
  
  
As a Senior Product Designer - Design Systems , you will lead the strategic evolution, governance, and architecture of Uplight’s core design system. You will step into an influential leadership role at the intersection of Design, Engineering, and Product Strategy—building a unified, accessible, and AI-optimized component architecture from the ground up to empower every product team across Uplight.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Drive the evolution of Uplight's design system by delivering high-quality visual assets—UI mockups, icons, illustrations, design tokens, and component specifications—that set the gold standard for visual consistency, craft, and accessibility across all products.
* Partner directly with cross-functional leadership and your team to establish a clear strategy, roadmap, and prioritization framework for Uplight’s design system, driving widespread adoption across all product lines.
* Audit, refine, and construct scalable UI components, design tokens, responsive layouts, and interaction patterns. Uncover opportunities to unify implementations across responsive and accessible surfaces.
* Collaborate closely with frontend engineering teams to ensure component structures, token naming, auto-layout rules, and variants directly mirror production code structure.
* Partner closely with UX product designers, product managers, and UI engineers to validate, scale, and ship design solutions that work seamlessly across responsive and accessible surfaces.
* Create clear documentation and usage guidance, including best practices, anti-patterns, and decision frameworks teams can act on.
* Establish clear contribution models, version control practices, and governance processes—including facilitating a company-wide working sessions—so designers across all products can continuously contribute without breaking system cohesion.
* Partner with engineering to explore and implement responsible AI tooling and automated workflows to optimize the design-to-code pipeline.
* Champion Accessibility, ensuring every component and interaction pattern adheres to WCAG AA accessibility standards by default.
* Host regular co-design sessions, training workshops, and office hours to educate product managers, engineers, and designers on system updates, best practices, and contribution patterns
* Champion a culture of continuous learning, feedback, and iteration.

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years of experience in digital product design, with a proven track record of creating, scaling, and maintaining enterprise-grade design systems in B2B or B2B2C software environments.
* High Design Craft & Component Execution: Deep expertise in component design, variants, interaction patterns, responsive layouts, micro-interactions, and visual design fundamentals.
* Exceptional standards for visual design and component work , delivering polished, production-ready UI components engineered to scale across complex software ecosystems.
* Expert proficiency in Figma advanced capabilities, including variables, design tokens, component properties, auto-layout, and library publishing workflows.
* Technical Fluency: Strong familiarity with frontend capabilities (React, Angular, Material UI / MUI) and component architecture to ensure seamless collaboration with engineering partners.
* Strong communication and storytelling skills . Ability to articulate the "why" behind system decisions, with a track record of producing clear, and actionable usage guidelines.
* Facilitation Skills . Experience establishing multi-team contribution frameworks and leading collaborative workshops that build cross-functional trust and drive alignment across the organization.
* Deep knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG AA) and a commitment to ensure all components and patterns are inclusive and usable.

**Bonu s Points**

* Comfortable jumping into c omplex technical domains with curiosity and humility .
* Experience in leveraging modern AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Figma MCP, automated spec-to-code generators) to streamline design system maintenance and deployment.
* Experience writing or governing component usage documentation at scale
* Fluency in Agile environments, meeting cadences, etc. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women, marginalized genders and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Uplight we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

What makes working at Uplight amazing: We are:
  
  

* Proud to be over 500+ purpose-driven individuals helping to create a more sustainable planet.
* Committed to the environment, our employees, and our communities.
* Focused on providing cross-functional work, collaboration, and development.
* Committed to taking our work and mission seriously and….we love to laugh!

Senior Specialist, Product Experience Design
  
  
**Overview**
We are looking for an experienced User Experience/Interaction Designer passionate about the possibilities of data and data-driven experience design with good knowledge and experience of User Interface Design to join our rapidly growing, highly-innovative data and services Product Development team at our development center in Pune.
  
  
The design function works as part of wider cross-functional teams that form organically around data product ideas – collectively contributing to the rapid iteration of Prototypes and MVPs (Minimal Viable Product), mainly in the B2B and B2B2C arenas. Each design iteration is exposed to end-users at each cycle of our rapid design-test-redesign process, to ensure optimum user traction. Prototype and MVP outputs include dashboards; widgets; chatbots; web applications; mobile applications; VUI voice interfaces; digital assistants; etc. – all in service of solving complex business challenges and with an ever increasing emphasis on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML).
  
  
Role
  
  

* Design of Proof-of-Concepts and Minimum Viable Data Products (MVPs) using human-centric design principles and rapid prototyping (Lean UX and Design Thinking)
* Participate in "Design Thinking" workshops – collaborating cross-functionally with industry verticals, regional leads and end-users to ensure optimal digital data products
* Explore the “art-of-the-possible” in the era of Big Data, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) – whilst always maintaining regulatory compliance
* Leverage existing – and contribute net new – design patterns to Mastercard’s design pattern library
* Help define the next generation of data and data-driven products – and through doing so, help shape the future of Mastercard and its growth
* Creation of a cohesive and compelling visual language across diverse form factors: web, mobile and internet of things
* Work on future state conceptual designs, driving experimentation that improves the quality of product design overall.
* Work closely with key partners from brand & marketing, alongside the broader user experience team to drive delightful and highly usable transactional experiences leveraging the broader visual language for MasterCard.
* Work closely with our technology team to define implementation standard for our products leveraging modern presentation layer practices such as adaptive/responsive web and current and forward thinking technologies.
* Ensure that designs deliver an appropriate balance of optimizing business objectives & user engagement, in close partnership with product managers.
* Liaise with regional and country teams to ensure that designs are reflective of the diversity of needs for a global user base
* Drive VXD design across a broader ecosystem, where experiences will require tailoring to meet the needs of both MasterCard customers and end consumers
* Help define the next generation of data and data-driven products and their visualization – and through doing so, help shape the future of Mastercard and its growth

**All About You**
Required Experience / Knowledge / Skills (Core)
  
  
**Interaction Design**

* Experience developing User Archetypes and Personas and user journeys to inform product design decisions
* Experience in rapid prototyping (Lean UX and Design Thinking)
* Experience in articulating elegant and engaging experiences using sketches, storyboards, information architecture blueprints and prototypes
* Experience in the implementation of creative, useable and compelling visual mockups and prototypes.
* Experience working with complex information architectures
* Experience of design-experiences across multiple media
* Experience using prototyping/wireframing tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe Experience Design, Adobe Illustrator etc.
* An understanding of complex information architectures for digital applications

**Visual Design**
Additional Experience / Knowledge / Skills
  
  

* Experience in articulating elegant and engaging visual experiences using sketches, storyboards, and within prototypes
* Highly proficient in the creation of useable, compelling and elegant visual mockups and prototypes.
* Experience of visual design across multiple media and form factors: web; mobile; Internet-of-Things (IOT)
* Extensive and demonstrable experience using leading VXD software packages such as Adobe Creative Cloud / Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator etc.) / Experience Design, Serif DrawPlus, Corel DRAW Graphics Suite / PaintShopPro, Art Rage, Xara or equivalent
* An understanding of complex information architectures for visual representation
* Any experience in motion graphic design is a strong plus
* Any experience in 3D modeling also a strong plus

**Research**

* Experience consuming UX research
* Experience in leading “Design Thinking” workshops with customers to identify requirements and ideate on potential product solutions.
* Ability to identify best-in-class user experience through competitor analysis
* Experience of iterative “design-test-re-design” methodology to collect real user feedback to incorporate back into the design

Candidate
  
  

* Prior experience working in a world-beating UX team
* Experience working/multi-tasking in an extremely fast-paced startup-like environment
* Experience in client-facing engagements, preferably in leading them
* Empathetic champion of the user – passionate about the detail of great usability, interaction design and aesthetics to give the best possible UX
* Passionate about the possibility of data driven experiences – so-called “emergent ontologies” (patterns in the data) driving UX and UI. Passionate about the potential for data, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning ML)
* Defensible point-of-view on and Adaptive v Responsive v Liquid/Fluid UI
* Defensible point-of-view on gamification
* Interest in VUIs (Voice Interfaces)
* Demonstrable knowledge of UX and Interaction Design heuristics and best practices: e.g. Lean UX; Mobile First etc.
* Demonstrable knowledge of ergonomic and usability best practices
* Bachelors or Masters Degree in Design for Interactive Media, or equivalent experience
* World-beating portfolio covering multiple form-factors: desktop; tablet; mobile; wearable; other
* Demonstrable commitment to learning: insatiable to discover and evaluate new concepts and technologies to maximize design possibility.

Corporate Security Responsibility
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Instructional Designer
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**Senior Instructional Designer / eLearning Developer**

Are you passionate about learning and development? Do you want to work in a high impact, collaborative, and innovative role? Teradata Technical Enablement is looking for an experienced Instructional Designer and eLearning Developer who wants to be a part of building exciting new Teradata Vantage technical courses (VILT and WBT) and microlearning videos on our Cloud and Vantage products. This team supports the learning and enablement of Teradata associates, customers, and partners across the enterprise - globally.

As a Senior Instructional Designer and eLearning Developer on our Technical Enablement team you will research, recommend, and produce a variety of complex, media rich, and highly interactive courses to up-level the knowledge and skills for our Go-to-Market teams, customers, and Partners. This key role will focus on leading and assisting the design, development and delivery of learning programs and enablement resources using a variety of formats including eLearning, virtual instructor-led, and blended learning methods. In this role you will collaborate with technical instructors on our team as well as a variety of other teams within Teradata (including Teradata User Experience, Customer Success, Partners, Consulting Services, Product Management, Marketing, Technical Sales, Solution Engineering, and more) to gather requirements and lead projects through the planning, design, implementation and evaluation lifecycle.

Teradata provides the leading cloud data analytics platform that enables companies to unlock continuous unlimited value from their data, and Teradata’s teams, customers and partners need training, and not just a couple of PowerPoint slides and a long lecture. Our Technical Enablement team, which you would be an instrumental member of, is developing highly technical end user and admin virtual instructor-led courses with extensive hands-on labs and interactive games. Our team also produces on-demand e-learning courses and microlearning videos that can be accessed 24x7 and self-paced labs that allow our associates deep into our technologies. You'll get to educate and play at the same time!

The successful candidate is a confident, articulate professional with a healthy technical knowledge of IT domains and the ability to translate technical content into easy-to-understand training. You have proven training, instructional design or technical documentation experience. You are experienced in designing and developing innovative learning solutions utilizing a variety of methods and tools. You use creative, engaging new approaches based on brain science, adult learning theories, and the latest educational technologies and trends. You have experience gathering requirements and assessing design needs to craft effective and efficient plans for performance solutions and services that address business-specific requirements and constraints. Above all, you will have a passion for learning.

**Responsibilities**

* Designs, develops and delivers technical learning using multiple technologies and modalities such as self-paced eLearning courses and microlearning, ILT/VILT classroom sessions, blended learning and performance support materials for customers, partners, and technical and consulting audiences
* Coordinates and manages the full training cycle as needed including requirements gathering, design/development meeting product release deadlines, in-person delivery and web-based learning, evaluation and metrics reporting
* Works with subject matter experts (SMEs) to produce content that is highly engaging and effective at empowering learner to immediately execute and apply knowledge
* Experiments with new approaches to learning which scale and drive engagement
* Creates training outlines, design plans, storyboards, and authors e-learning content and blended solutions
* Transforms ILT and VILT content into interactive WBTs, with engaging activities, microlearning videos, quizzes, animations, games, job aids, lab guides, etc.
* Provides expert consultation on learning techniques, instructional design theory and digital technology solutions for eLearning and classroom/virtual classroom

**Minimum Qualifications**

Candidate must have 5-8+ years of experience as an Instructional Designer / eLearning Developer, preferably for technical or product release enablement. The candidate must have demonstrated experience with multiple types of learning solutions (including, but not limited to e-learning courses, mobile learning, simulations, microlearning, ILT and VILT programs, and blended learning/flipped classroom). The candidate must also have experience creating learning solutions for technical audiences (e.g., data scientists, citizen data scientists, business analysts, data engineers, database administrators, cloud administrators, devops, consulting services, customer success managers, solution engineers, or technical sales).

* Degree in Educational Technology, Instructional Design, or similar field preferred
* In-depth knowledge and proficiency with course authoring tools including Articulate Storyline and Rise, Adobe Captivate, TechSmith Camtasia, and office tools such as PowerPoint, Excel and Word.
* In-depth knowledge and proficiency creating microlearning videos
* Challenge existing models and processes to design innovative learning that can be used just-in-time and provide on-the-job performance support
* Comfortable working in an environment that is constantly evolving
* Team player with superior people skills and a positive attitude
* Proven self-starter with ability to juggle priorities and manage expectations
* Robust communication skills (verbal, written) including ability to present, facilitate, and influence
* Strong critical thinker with ability to ramp-up quickly on new products, applications and systems
* Independent problem solver who will take initiative and execute work
* Must be deadline driven, organized and able to multi-task

These skills are a plus:

* Domain expertise in one or more of the following: Infrastructure, Networking, Database, Systems Administration, Cloud Technology
* Coding in SQL language
* HTML programming and other related programming skills to create learning websites and tools
* Authoring technical documentation
* Creating SharePoint sites
* Designing and/or building microlearning libraries
* Creating learning content in Saba learning management system
* Generating Excel learning metrics reports
* Scheduling of session offerings to global audiences
* Experience with graphic development tools such as Adobe Photoshop
* Experience with Microsoft Teams, Trello, Kanban, Jira, MS project or other project management tools

* **Generate Insights:**

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
**About Revun**
Revun is building a next-generation software platform designed to modernize how property owners, property managers, brokerages, maintenance providers, service professionals, and real estate organizations operate.
  
  
The platform combines CRM, leasing, maintenance, accounting, payments, communications, workflow automation, compliance, reporting, AI, integrations, and stakeholder portals into a single operating platform.
  
  
Our goal is not to build another collection of disconnected software tools. We are building an operational platform that simplifies complex business processes, reduces manual work, improves visibility, and helps organizations operate more efficiently.
  
  
The product is already underway, and we are now looking for a strong product designer who can help turn a complex platform into an intuitive, professional, scalable, and commercially ready user experience.
  
  
**About The Role**
Revun is hiring a
**Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)**
to lead the design of our web and mobile product experience.
  
  
This is not a graphic design role, and it is not a role focused only on creating attractive screens.
  
  
We are looking for someone who understands how to design real software products, including complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, dashboards, workflows, portals, mobile apps, and multi-user systems.
  
  
You will work closely with leadership, engineering, and product stakeholders to simplify complex workflows, improve usability, create scalable design systems, and help prepare the platform for commercial launch.
  
  
The successful candidate must be able to think through product flows, user journeys, permissions, edge cases, responsive layouts, information hierarchy, and design handoff — not just visual styling.
  
  
You should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve your design process, speed up research and ideation, organize complex requirements, generate UX copy, explore layout options, create user flows, and improve documentation while still applying your own product judgment.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Please submit your
**resume and portfolio**
for consideration.
  
  
Your portfolio should include examples of real product-design work, such as user flows, dashboards, complex interfaces, mobile screens, design systems, marketplace workflows, SaaS platforms, or similar product examples.
  
  
Candidates with only branding, landing pages, social media graphics, or marketing websites will not be the strongest fit for this role.
  
  
Qualified candidates will be invited to complete a pre-recorded video interview 24-48 hours after applying as the next step in the hiring process.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design user-friendly web and mobile experiences for a complex SaaS and marketplace-style platform
* Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and developer-ready UI specifications
* Design workflows for multiple user types, including internal users, property owners, tenants, vendors, service providers, partners, and administrators
* Translate complex business processes into simple, intuitive product experiences
* Work closely with leadership and engineering to turn product vision into clear, usable, buildable designs
* Improve the overall information architecture, navigation, dashboard structure, forms, portals, workflows, and mobile experience
* Design and maintain scalable design systems, reusable components, UI patterns, and style standards
* Create clean, professional, modern, and consistent product interfaces
* Identify gaps, edge cases, confusing user flows, and areas where the product experience can be simplified
* Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are technically feasible and implemented accurately
* Review builds and provide design QA feedback before release
* Use AI tools responsibly to speed up research, ideation, UX writing, documentation, design exploration, and workflow development
* Validate AI-assisted design outputs through human judgment, user needs, business requirements, and product logic
* Support commercial launch readiness by ensuring the platform is easy to understand, easy to use, and visually consistent

**Required Experience**

* 6+ years of UX/UI, Product Design, or related digital product design experience
* Experience designing complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, CRM systems, workflow platforms, fintech products, operational dashboards, or other multi-role software products
* Strong experience designing both web and mobile product experiences
* Strong Figma skills, including components, Auto Layout, variants, design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff
* Experience designing dashboards, forms, tables, workflows, portals, user profiles, settings, notifications, and role-based user experiences
* Experience working directly with engineers and product stakeholders
* Strong understanding of user flows, information architecture, interaction design, usability, visual hierarchy, responsive design, and design systems
* Experience using AI tools to support design work, UX writing, research synthesis, user-flow creation, wireframing, prototyping, or product documentation
* Ability to explain design decisions clearly and connect them to user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility
* Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished, developer-ready designs
* Strong written and spoken English
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

**Strongly Preferred Experience**

* Experience designing marketplace platforms or multi-sided products
* Experience with property technology, real estate platforms, maintenance platforms, field-service software, booking platforms, fintech, CRM systems, or enterprise workflow software
* Experience designing products with multiple user types and role-based permissions
* Experience designing payment, transaction, vendor, booking, service-request, or dashboard workflows
* Experience designing AI-powered product features or AI-assisted workflows
* Experience improving an existing product rather than only designing from scratch
* Experience working in startups or fast-moving product environments
* Experience with usability testing, product analytics, user research, or customer feedback loops
* Experience creating design systems from the ground up

AI Expectations
  
  
We are looking for a designer who uses AI as a productivity tool, not as a substitute for product judgment.
  
  
**You Should Be Comfortable Using AI To Help With**

* UX research organization
* User-flow exploration
* Wireframe ideation
* Interface-copy options
* Product requirement organization
* Edge-case discovery
* Design-system documentation
* Competitive research summaries
* Prototype concepts
* Usability-test summaries
* Design iteration

However, you must still review, validate, and improve all AI-assisted work yourself. Final design decisions must be based on user needs, product logic, business goals, usability, accessibility, and technical feasibility.
  
  
The Person We Are Looking For
  
  
You are a true product thinker.
  
  
You do not just make screens look good — you understand how people actually use software.
  
  
You can take a complicated workflow and make it feel clear, simple, and logical.
  
  
You are comfortable designing for different types of users who each need different information, permissions, dashboards, and actions.
  
  
You think through edge cases, empty states, errors, mobile responsiveness, role-based access, data-heavy screens, and developer handoff.
  
  
You are confident working with engineers and leadership, and you can explain why a design decision matters.
  
  
You are also comfortable using AI to work faster, explore more options, and improve your process, while still owning the quality of the final product.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  

* The platform becomes easier to understand and easier to use
* Core workflows are redesigned with clearer user journeys
* Web and mobile experiences become more consistent and polished
* Developers receive clear, complete, buildable design specifications
* The design system becomes scalable and reusable
* Product screens feel modern, professional, and commercially ready
* Users can complete important tasks with less confusion and fewer unnecessary steps
* AI is used responsibly to improve speed, quality, and documentation
* Design work directly supports product launch and long-term platform growth

**Compensation**
The monthly compensation range for this role is:
  
  
CAD $24,000–$36,000 annually

title: AI UX/UI Designer/Researcher
description:
- - - - - - - - - - - -
  
  
Experienced or senior profile, reporting directly to the Chief Design Officer. Cross-functional role serving a community of sixty designers across France, India, the United States and China.
  
  
**Why this role -**
Our teams have been experimenting with AI for more than two years. The need is not to start the movement, but to turn these local initiatives into reliable, reusable and shared practices.
  
  
The person will start from real work: identify the uses that matter, improve them on live projects and enable other teams to adopt them. AI is the field of action; DesignOps is the lever; the quality of the user experience remains the compass.
  
  
**Mission**

* Move AI uses from individual experimentation to collective practices that hold up in production.
* The scope covers user research, interface design, content and the design system. The person works alongside the teams, without replacing UX Leads or imposing a single tool on everyone.

**Understand And Build On What Already Exists**

* Go into the hubs, observe practices and collect concrete examples. Identify what delivers real value, what remains fragile and what is duplicated.
* Expected deliverables: a map of current uses, documented examples and a shortlist of topics to pool first.

**Build and harden the workflow**
s
  
  

* Work on real projects to design repeatable ways of working: inputs, steps, tools, human checks, expected outputs and limits.
* A workflow must be usable by someone other than its author, at a verifiable level of quality.
* Expected deliverables: tested workflows, reusable templates and explicit validation criteria.

**Organise their day-to-day use**

* Make practices easy to find, understand and maintain. Clarify who owns them, how they evolve and when they should be retired. Align uses with the design system and with internal frameworks governing tools and data.
* Expected deliverables: a maintained reference space, clear ownership and a lightweight process for flagging issues.

**Work with the teams and pass it on**

* Support designers on their deliverables, pair with them, make trade-offs visible and help local champions become autonomous.
* Training can help, but it is not the purpose of the role. Success shows in the practices that remain once the person has left the room.

**Measure the real contribution**

* Assess the impact on working time, rework, deliverable quality and team autonomy. Tell an impressive demo apart from a lasting gain.
* Expected deliverables: before/after comparisons and reasoned decisions to continue, adapt or stop a use.

**What The Role Is Not**

* This is not a trend-watching or evangelism role disconnected from projects, nor a job producing training courses or prompt libraries. The person is not expected to build every technical integration alone, nor to approve every team experiment.
* They must be technical enough to understand, prototype and engage with IT, without losing their product design expertise.

**First expected results: three-month proposal**

* Month one: understand the hubs' practices, identify champions and select a few use cases based on observed problems.
* Month two: test two or three workflows on projects, with a baseline and quality criteria defined with the teams.
* Month three: have at least one workflow adopted by another team, document the conditions for success and set up its maintenance.

***he first sign of success is not the number of people trained: it is a useful practice, adopted elsewhere, with no permanent dependence on its author**
.*

title: Senior Industrial Designer (Hardware, Soft Goods, CMF)
description:
Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Type: Contract / Full Time

**About HLTH**

HLTH is one of the fastest growing brands of 2026, reaching the top 0.1% in hyper-growth of all stores in the Shopify ecosystem and we're just getting started (literally). At HLTH we believe understanding your health should be effortless. Our products turn health monitoring into clear insights anyone can act on.

**Before you apply**

HLTH is an intense environment: we're demanding and ambitious, which means we ask a lot of ourselves and one another. This means fantastic learning, achievements, and career growth, but it also requires a significant commitment. We move fast, standards are high, and ownership is real. This is not a coast job. If you want to be challenged, stretched, and pushed harder than ever before, we invite you to apply.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Senior Industrial Designer to help define the future of HLTH hardware and wearable experiences. This role is for a designer who thrives between vision and execution, while obsessing over the details of material, form, fit, finish, comfort, manufacturing and user behavior. 

As a Senior Industrial Designer, you will work hand in hand with the founders across our next generation of products, accessories, and wearables. Collaborating with Product, Growth, and Manufacturing to bring products to market. 

The candidate who fills this job shapes how HLTH shows up in daily life. The ideal candidate has deep experience designing wearables, complex consumer hardware, has refined taste, ergonomic intuition, and the ability to drive a product from exploration to mass production.

Note: While the role is fully remote, travel to factories for key builds may be required.

**What You'll Do**

**Vision & Concept Development**

* Drive the full design process from initial ideation to mass production, owning both creative vision and execution quality.
* Introduce breakthrough ideas that challenge category norms and expand our design language across wearables and connected home products.
* Translate market and user insights into design strategies, product architectures, and differentiated physical experiences.
* Advocate for the user’s point of view in cross-functional discussions, connecting insights to design and business goals.

**Execution, Craft & Human Factors**

* Develop and visualize compelling product concepts through sketching, CAD, and high-quality 2D/3D renderings.
* Design across hard goods, soft goods, and hybrid assemblies—integrating plastics, metals, technical textiles, and silicones for on-body and in-home environments.
* Set the bar for design craft—proportion, surface continuity, and detailing that communicates premium design intent.
* Direct the physical prototyping process with factory partners and local fabrication vendors, evaluating appearance models, 3D prints, and wearable samples for fit, finish, and comfort.
* Drive ergonomic and wearability evaluations on vendor-provided samples to validate human factors and real-world performance.

**CMF, Technical Delivery & Factory Execution**

* Lead CMF direction and own the physical sampling process with suppliers (swatches, resin pucks, golden samples) to ensure every material, finish, and color matches design intent.
* Own end-to-end design documentation, including master surface CAD files, CMF specs, tech packs, product labeling guidance, and design rationale.
* Collaborate closely with global mechanical engineering and manufacturing partners to solve complex packaging and assembly challenges.
* Navigate constraints without sacrificing design quality—ensuring the final product stays true to the original vision while meeting cost, tooling, and production requirements.
* Balance speed and execution quality to ensure efficient handoff and successful mass production.
* Present design concepts and technical recommendations clearly and confidently to internal leadership and manufacturing partners.

**Must-Have**

* Bachelor’s degree (BA, BS, or BFA) in Industrial Design, Product Design, or a closely related field.
* 6+ years of professional industrial design experience shipping physical consumer products from concept through mass production.
* A portfolio demonstrating shipped hardware across both rigid enclosures (plastics, metals) and flexible soft goods (textiles, silicone, or cut-and-sew constructions).
* AI-native mindset: active, bold experimentation with generative AI and emerging tools to radically compress design cycles and explore broader concept spaces, held to the same uncompromising production quality bar as traditional craft.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct user research, ergonomic studies, and fit evaluations, translating human factors insights into physical form.
* Experience developing or expanding a cohesive design language across diverse product categories rather than single-sku lines.
* Advanced proficiency in 3D surface modeling (SolidWorks, Rhino, or Creo), rendering tools (KeyShot), and Adobe Creative Suite.
* Proven experience authoring comprehensive factory deliverables: master surface CAD, detailed CMF matrices, and soft-goods tech packs.
* Practical understanding of design for manufacturing (DFM), draft angles, parting lines, and collaborating with mechanical engineers on internal packaging constraints.
* Direct experience managing the vendor sampling process, including evaluating physical CMF swatches, reviewing tooling parts (T1/T2), and approving golden samples.
* Experience directing external model shops, rapid-prototyping vendors, or factory partners to produce appearance and functional evaluation samples.
* Working knowledge of modern generative AI design and visualization tools to accelerate early ideation and concept workflows.
* Strong visual, written, and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate design rationale clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership.
* Proven ability to work independently, manage multiple product tracks simultaneously, and maintain execution quality under tight timelines.

**Strong Preference**

* Master’s degree (MS / MA / MID) in Industrial Design or related field.
* Prior experience designing body-worn hardware, sleep tech, smart rings, or personal audio devices.
* Understanding of skin-contact materials, sweat resistance, and basic biocompatibility considerations.
* Experience working directly with manufacturing partners and tier-1 suppliers in Taiwan, Vietnam, India, or mainland China.
* Experience working in high-growth consumer hardware startups, direct-to-consumer brands, or agile hardware environments.

**Compensation**

Pay is based on region and experience, set as a geo-calibrated range. Exact compensation depends on the candidate's skills, level, experience, and track record, and not all candidates will sit at the top of the range.

**What's in it for you**

* Fully remote, flexible hours
* Access to custom AI tooling and workflows
* Flat team, direct access to founders
* Unlimited PTO (with a required recharge time)
* Room to grow as the hardware team scales

**Our hiring process**

1. Application and portfolio review
2. Screening interview
3. Design test (portfolio deep-dive and a short brief) with Founders
4. Team interview
5. Offer & Compensation (if accepted)

Send your CV and portfolio. Show 2 products you took to mass production, with photos of the shipped product next to the renders, and tell us your role, the materials and the manufacturing process. Include one tech pack, CMF spec or packaging die-line example you wrote.

* Our jobs are only listed on trusted job boards, our direct profile, or 99 Commerce staffing agency.
* We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment information upfront.

Stay cautious and protect your personal details.

title: UI Designer
company: Monsoonfish Inc. UX & UI Design agency
description:
**About Monsoonfish**
Monsoonfish is a design and brand strategy studio in Pune. We do UX/UI design, product strategy and corporate branding for forward-thinking clients and for our own products. We care about high integrity, extreme ownership and quality that shows in the pixels, more than we care about rigid structure.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We're looking for a UI Designer who sweats the details and ships beautiful, usable interfaces in Figma. You'll design screens, flows and components for client products and Monsoonfish's own initiatives, working alongside our UX designers, brand designers and product strategists. Good taste, clean execution and a habit of owning your work matter more to us than a long résumé.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design polished interfaces. Turn wireframes, briefs and rough ideas into high-fidelity UI for websites, web apps and mobile products.
* Build and maintain design systems. Create reusable components, styles and variables in Figma so our work stays consistent and fast to scale.
* Own the details. Typography, spacing, colour, hierarchy, states, micro-interactions. You catch what others miss.
* Collaborate closely. Work with UX designers, brand designers, strategists and developers, and take feedback well.
* Prepare clean handoffs. Organised files, clear specs and annotations so developers can build without guessing.
* Stay on brand. Adapt your visual style to each client's identity while keeping the Monsoonfish quality bar.
* Contribute to Monsoonfish itself. Support internal products, pitch decks, case studies and the occasional brand or social visual.

**What We Look For**

* 2+ years of experience designing UI for digital products, in an agency, studio or product team.
* Great Figma execution: auto layout, components, variants, variables and prototyping.
* A strong portfolio that shows visual craft and a clear reason behind your choices.
* A sharp eye for typography, layout, colour and visual hierarchy.
* Working knowledge of UX fundamentals, accessibility basics and responsive design.
* Comfort handing off to developers with clean files and clear specs.
* Motion or prototyping skills, branding sensibility, or experience with AI tools in your design workflow.

**Who You Are**

* Extreme ownership. You don't wait to be told. You spot gaps, make a call and see it through.
* High integrity. You're honest, direct and committed to top-tier delivery.
* Collaborative. You share ideas openly, welcome critique and ask for help when you need it.
* Curious. You keep learning and look at great work with a critical eye.
* Flexible. We don't watch the clock, but you're willing to stretch when a critical client delivery needs it.

**How We'll Measure Success**

* Design quality: polished, consistent, on-brand work that needs few rounds of revision.
* Delivery: projects shipped on schedule with clean, developer-ready files.
* System health: well-maintained components and libraries that others can build on.
* Collaboration: smooth working relationships with design, strategy and dev teammates.
* Growth: steady improvement in craft, speed and independence.

**Culture, Perks And How To Apply**

* Output-driven freedom. We don't track hours or micromanage your day. Do great work with integrity and you get real autonomy.
* Visible impact. Your work shows up daily in products and brands that go out to clients.

title: UX Researcher (Behavioural, Anthropology, Ethanography) (GB03/04)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

The User Researcher is responsible for generating deep, psychology-backed insights into user behavior, motivations, and decision-making within fintech and digital financial products. The role focuses on applying behavioral science, cognitive psychology, and quantitative/qualitative research methods to uncover latent user needs and translate them into actionable inputs for design, product, and business strategy. The role ensures user-centric, evidence-based decision-making across the organization.

**A - Minimum required Accountabilities for this role-**

* Conduct in-depth moderated and unmoderated user interviews using psychological frameworks (e.g., Prospect Theory, Cognitive Dissonance, System 1 & 2) to uncover latent motivations, emotional drivers, and behavioral barriers.
* Design, deploy, and analyze quantitative research studies (surveys, questionnaires, experiments) grounded in validated psychological models such as Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), Big Five Personality Traits, and Self-Determination Theory.
* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into actionable insights by identifying underlying cognitive and behavioral patterns (e.g., loss aversion, anchoring bias, trust erosion).
* Translate research findings into structured outputs such as personas, mental models, journey maps, and behavioral frameworks that predict user behavior.
* Test UI/UX prototypes through usability and concept validation studies using tools like Figma, Maze, and UserTesting, leveraging models such as Fogg’s Behavior Model.
* Own end-to-end research execution including study design, participant recruitment, psychometric segmentation, data analysis, and insight storytelling.

**B - Additional Accountabilities pertaining to the role-**

* Partner closely with design, product, and business teams to convert behavioral insights into bias-aware recommendations, nudges, and experience improvements.
* Monitor fintech and behavioral science trends (e.g., hyperbolic discounting, decision fatigue) through diary studies, ethnographic research, and secondary analysis.
* Support business KPIs such as conversion, engagement, retention, and trust through evidence-backed research inputs.
* Contribute to the development of internal research standards, methodologies, and best practices.

Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong Behavioral Research / Behavioral Insights / Consumer Behavior Research Profiles
* Mandatory (Experience 1): Must have 2+ years of experience in Behavioral Research, Consumer Behavior Analysis, Behavioral Science, or Market Research, focusing on understanding user motivations, decision patterns, and digital behavior
* Mandatory (Experience 2): Must have hands-on experience conducting primary and secondary research, including qualitative and quantitative research methods such as interviews, ethnographic studies, surveys, behavioral experiments, and observational research
* Mandatory (Experience 3) : Experience analyzing user behavior patterns, engagement trends, and digital interaction journeys to generate insights that influence product design, feature development, or platform experience improvements
* Mandatory (Experience 4): Must have exposure to data analysis or data mining of user behavior datasets, combining research insights with behavioral data to identify patterns, anomalies, or opportunities for product innovation
* Mandatory (Skills 1): Strong understanding of Behavioral Science principles such as Cognitive Bias, Cognitive Dissonance, System 1 & System 2 Thinking, Decision Science, or Consumer Psychology
* Mandatory (Skills 2): Experience in testing concepts, prototypes, or product ideas through usability testing, concept validation, or behavioral experimentation to evaluate user response and product effectiveness
* Mandatory (Skills 3): Ability to synthesize research findings into actionable insights, hypotheses, and recommendations for Product, Design, or Business teams
* Mandatory (Skills 4): Basic understanding of UI/UX and digital product journeys, including how users interact with mobile apps or web platforms, though this is not a design role
* Candidates from institutes with strong behavioral research exposure are preferred
* Mandatory (Company): Candidates from B2C consumer product organizations where user behavior is closely tracked and analyzed, such as consumer tech, fintech, e-commerce, or digital platforms
* Mandatory (Note):This is not a pure UX Researcher or Data Analyst role. The client is looking for Design Thinking–oriented Behavioral Researchers who combine behavioral science, research methodologies, and behavioral data analysis to generate insights
* Preferred (Skills): Exposure to behavioral experimentation, usability testing, journey analysis, or consumer psychology frameworks used to improve digital product experience
* Preferred (Education): Background in Behavioral Science, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Ethnography, Cognitive Science, or related fields (BA/MA/MSc/BSc)
* Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years

Experience: 2–7 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days

title: CX Analyst & Product Insights  (B2C, Tier-1) (GB04)
description: Roles & Responsibilities We’re building a central Design Thinking function at Bajaj Finance - a team that will play a defining role as the organisation pivots into a direct-to-consumer company. This role sits at the intersection of data and human understanding, and thrives in that grey zone. You’ll be the person who can stare at a funnel and see a human story. Who can sit with a field research readout and spot what’s missing. Who treats data not as an answer, but as a better question - and turns both into something the team can act on. What Your Work Looks Like- You’ll operate across the Design Thinking lifecycle — from signal to solution: Insight & Evidence: Journey analytics, Mining session replays, heatmaps, and behavioural data to surface where customers struggle and why. You bring statistical rigour — you know the difference between a pattern and noise, between correlation and causation, and you know when to trust the data and when to trust instinct. Challenge & Synthesis: You consume field research from dedicated research teams and stress-test it. You triangulate digital signals against qualitative findings, competitive benchmarks, and business metrics to build problem statements that hold up under scrutiny. You craft How Might We statements from clustered signals — framing the right questions that give the team a clear direction to solve against. Prototyping & Testing: You participate in solutioning — helping the team move from problem to prototype, designing tests, and closing the loop between what was hypothesised and what customers actually do. What Makes Someone Right for This- 4–8 years in consumer insights, CX analytics, product analytics, UX research, or a similar role in B2C or consumer-facing companies, where you’ve worked across quantitative and qualitative inputs Comfortable in analytics platforms — session replay, web/app analytics, funnel analysis, segmented and cohort analysis. Can layer behavioural data over system-of-record data to move beyond surface-level insights. Specific tools matter less than your ability to get depth from any tool quickly Understands statistical thinking — hypothesis testing, significance, when to apply rigour and when to move on intuition Can read, challenge, and build on qualitative research even if you’re not the one conducting it — you know what good methodology looks like and can spot when a finding is thin Structures findings into clear, concise arguments. You’ve presented to senior stakeholders and know the difference between showing data and making a case Thinks in systems — you connect a drop-off at step 3 to an upstream design choice, a policy constraint, and a downstream business metric without being told to SQL-literate — you can pull what you need or speak to data teams in their language Brings critical reasoning that stress-tests assumptions rather than confirming them RequirementsIdeal Candidate Strong Consumer Insights / CX Analytics / Product Insights profile (behavioral/user/product/UX analytics) Mandatory (Experience 1) - Must have 4+ years of experience in Customer Experience (CX) Analytics, Consumer Insights, Product Analytics, Behavioral Analytics, or UX Analytics, working on B2C digital products (Web/App) with a focus on understanding customer behavior, customer journeys, and experience improvement. Mandatory (Experience 2) - Must have hands-on experience analyzing customer journeys, behavioral funnels, digital interactions, session-level behavior, clickstream data, and experience metrics to identify pain points, drop-offs, and optimization opportunities. Mandatory (Experience 3) - Must have experience using CX and Digital Experience Analytics platforms such as Medallia, ContentSquare, Google Analytics (GA4) or similar tools for customer behavior analysis, journey mapping, and insight generation. Mandatory (Experience 4) - Must have experience working closely with Product, Design, CX, Business, Marketing, and Research teams to generate insights, validate hypotheses, and drive customer experience improvements. Mandatory (Experience 5 ) - Strong working knowledge of SQL and Python for data extraction, querying, analysis, exploratory data analysis, automation, and behavioral data interpretation. Ability to independently analyze large datasets, identify patterns, and generate actionable business insights. Mandatory (Experience 6): Understanding of hypothesis-driven thinking and basic experimentation/A/B testing concepts, including interpreting results and distinguishing between correlation and causation. Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years Preferred ( Experience 1) - Candidates from product-based companies (B2C preferred) OR Data Analytics Service companies like Mu Sigma etc Experience: 3–6 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days BenefitsOur people define our passion and our audacious, incredibly rewarding achievements. Do you enjoy creating learning experiences that help customers and partners build the skills they need to succeed? If so, Johnson Controls has an opportunity for you.
  
  
As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places, and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Make an impact, grow your expertise, and work with innovative products and people who are shaping the future of our industry.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
The Senior Instructional Designer will support the Partner Enablement organization by designing and developing instructor-led training, virtual instructor-led training, eLearning, videos, and performance support resources for customers and channel partners. Working closely with Partner Enablement leaders, instructors, and subject matter experts, this role will translate complex technical concepts into effective learning experiences that drive product knowledge, technical proficiency, and business results.
  
  
**How You Will Do It**

* Design and develop engaging learning solutions, including instructor-led training, virtual instructor-led training, eLearning, video-based learning, learning guides, and job aids.
* Partner with business stakeholders and subject matter experts to analyze learning needs and develop effective training programs.

* Manage multiple learning projects simultaneously while meeting quality, timeline, and stakeholder expectations.
* Leverage learning technologies, authoring tools, multimedia solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities to enhance learning experiences.
* Support curriculum maintenance and content updates to align with product releases, business priorities, and learner feedback.
* Ensure learning content is accurate, consistent, scalable, and aligned with global standards.
* Measure learning effectiveness and recommend continuous improvements based on learner feedback, business needs, and performance outcomes.
* Stay current on instructional design best practices, learning technologies, and emerging trends within the learning and development industry.
* Contribute to a collaborative global learning team environment focused on delivering high-quality customer and partner education:

**What We Look For**

* 5-10 years of experience designing and developing learning solutions.
* 5+ years of instructional design experience, including curriculum development and storyboarding.
* Experience developing instructor-led training (ILT), virtual instructor-led training (vILT), eLearning, and multimedia learning solutions.
* Experience partnering with subject matter experts and business stakeholders to develop technical training programs.
* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience supporting corporate learning and development programs in a global organization preferred.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Education, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* Knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies, including ADDIE and Agile.

**Technical Skills**


* Experience with learning authoring and multimedia development tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise, Camtasia, Vyond, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar applications.
* Experience working with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and learning technologies.
* Ability to analyze learning effectiveness and recommend improvements.
* Ability to quickly learn Johnson Controls products, solutions, and industry concepts.

Professional Skills
  
  

* Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Ability to build effective relationships across global teams and stakeholder groups.
* Demonstrated accountability, professionalism, attention to detail, and customer focus.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, collaborative environment

• 4+ years' experience in instructional design, learning design or digital learning.

• Experience working with SMEs

• Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive learning design.

• Experience working with eLearning authoring and content-development teams.

• Strong written communication and attention to detail.

title: Product Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
OpenGov is seeking a Product Engineer to own key foundational areas of our Public Service Platform, leading cross-functional efforts, executing discovery, and driving delivery from spec through launch. These service areas include our Identity and Access Management capabilities, powering secure access for government users, public users, and internal staff. This is the career-level role: someone who operates independently, communicates proactively, and takes clear accountability for product outcomes while leveraging AI-native tooling for execution.
  
  
**How AI Works In This Role**
AI-native tooling handles a significant portion of what product managers and UX designers have historically spent their time on. That time is yours to redirect toward higher-leverage work. Specifically:
  
  

* Spec writing: AI drafts the first spec from your intent statement. You review, sharpen, and own what gets built.
* UX design: AI generates mockups from the design system based on your flow definitions. Experience Architects maintain the system itself. You make the product decisions within it.
* Shipping code: AI helps you ship features alongside engineering counterparts, this is no longer a handoff but now a process where everyone ships.
* Research synthesis: AI clusters and themes interview notes, call transcripts, and support data. You interpret what it means for the roadmap and make the call.
* Release content: AI generates release notes, in-app announcements, and enablement materials from your shipped features.
* Code review: Automated review catches style, security, and regression issues. You stay accountable for quality outcomes — not the review queue.
* Test coverage: AI generates test cases from the acceptance criteria you write. Your job is to write criteria that are precise enough to verify.
* Competitive intelligence: AI monitors competitor moves and surfaces market signals. You form the point of view and decide what it means for your roadmap.

*What AI does not do: understand your customers, make the call on what matters, own the outcome, or build the cross-functional trust that makes things ship. That is the job.*
**What You'll Own**

* Define and communicate the product vision for your area - grounded in customer research, competitive context, and business goals; not inherited from a committee.
* Conduct and synthesize customer discovery: translate what you hear into clear, defensible decisions about what to build and what to cut.
* Own the product roadmap: prioritize ruthlessly, explain your reasoning publicly, and revise it when new facts warrant it.
* Shipping code to production: you have the agency to ship code all the way to production, not just creating prototypes.
* Define user experience flows and interaction patterns within the design system; escalate to Experience Architects when genuinely new system-level patterns are required.
* Write clear intent documents that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI-generated specs for accuracy, completeness, and correctness.
* Partner with engineering to unblock builds, resolve ambiguity in real time, and make decisions during the development cycle without becoming a bottleneck.
* Track adoption, usage, and business outcome metrics; use them to drive the next iteration, not just to report status.
* Represent your product in customer conversations, QBRs, and cross-functional reviews — the full commercial picture, not just the feature set.
* Identify gaps in AI harnesses and design system coverage; surface them as platform investment requests with clear business justification.

**Qualifications & Preferred Experience**

* 4–6 years of experience in product management, UX design, or a closely adjacent role, with a demonstrated track record of shipping products customers use.
* Demonstrated experience building and implementing Access Control systems at scale, including working with internal stakeholders to onboard new products.
* Ability to conduct and synthesize customer discovery and translate findings into prioritized roadmap decisions.
* Proactively identifies challenges and communicates issues early; strong written and verbal skills.
* Connects different functional areas and understands their interdependencies within the broader organization.
* Comfortable defining user experience flows and working within a design system.
* Proficient or actively developing proficiency in AI-native workflows.
* SaaS product experience required; B2G background welcome.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.
